name: Deploy OfficeIMO Website

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: deploy-website
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout PSWriteOffice
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: EvotecIT/PSWriteOffice
          path: PSWriteOffice
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Build website
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          ./Website/build.ps1 -SkipBuildTool -CI -PSWriteOfficeRoot ./PSWriteOffice

      - name: Verify website
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          ./Website/verify.ps1 -CI

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_branch: gh-pages
          publish_dir: ./Website/_site
          user_name: "github-actions[bot]"
          user_email: "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          commit_message: "Deploy website from ${{ github.sha }}"
          full_commit_message: "Deploy website from ${{ github.sha }} on ${{ github.event_name }}"
          force_orphan: true

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages (optional)
        if: ${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN != '' && env.CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID_OFFICEIMO != '' }}
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID_OFFICEIMO: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID_OFFICEIMO }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          command: pages deploy
          workingDirectory: ./Website/_site
          environment: production
